name: Bitcoin and Solana Wallet Tracker
description: Tracks public Bitcoin and Solana wallet balances you enter and proposes them as holdings for your approval. Keyless public sources only.
author: HelloHQ

permissions.reason: Reads public balances for the wallet addresses you enter from mempool.space, Blockstream Esplora and the Solana public RPC.
May suggest new crypto holdings. Nothing is saved until you approve it.
May suggest a dated value for a holding. Nothing is saved until you approve it.
